threats.title: Malformed MQTT packet injection
threats.impact: Broker crash or incorrect message routing
threats.mitigation: All packet parsers use length-checked slicing; malformed packets cause early return, not panic

threats.title: Topic wildcard injection
threats.mitigation: match_topic enforces §4.7 system-topic protection; '$' topics not matched by bare '#' or '+'

threats.title: Channel overflow via high-rate publish
threats.mitigation: BackPressurePolicy (DropNewest/DropOldest/Block) configured per subscription; default DropNewest prevents blocking

threats.title: CONNACK spoofing (return code 0 on rejection)
threats.mitigation: CONNACK return code checked; ConnectionRefused returned for non-zero codes. TLS feature available for transport security.

threats.title: Payload size exhaustion
threats.mitigation: Maximum payload controlled by channel capacity; PayloadTooLarge sentinel defined for upper-layer enforcement
